architecture_constraints: One new credential-free QA workflow only; no HMP changes
Coder writes JSON artifacts only; Core performs authorized native MCP calls

increments.specification: Write only workflow.json: object {nodes:[...]}. Each node has exactly name,type,version,parameters. Ordered nodes QA Webhook/n8n-nodes-base.webhook/2.2; QA Result/n8n-nodes-base.set/3.5; QA Response/n8n-nodes-base.respondToWebhook/1.5. Set uses mode raw and jsonOutput expression; respondWith json, responseBody expression, options.responseCode expression. All expressions must be pure n8n ={{ ... }} with $json, body fields, Number.isFinite, typeof, startsWith, ternaries and literal bounds. No arrays/computed property access, functions, loops, globals, credentials or network. Implement the contract exactly; no extra response fields. Core writes remote-draft.json; do not manufacture it.
inputs: Approved QA contract and objective evidence
acceptance_criteria: Contract and mandatory independent verification pass

increments.specification: Write only publication.json: {action:"publish",workflow_id:<recorded own ID>,version_id:<reviewed version>}. Do not change workflow.json or perform external operations. Core publishes and independently verifies the reviewed version.
inputs: Approved QA contract and objective evidence
acceptance_criteria: Contract and mandatory independent verification pass
